Class InstanceTextProcessor

java.lang.Object
me.leoko.advancedgui.utils.InstanceTextProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
TextProcessor
public class InstanceTextProcessor extends Object implements TextProcessor
Substitutes %instance.&lt;key&gt;% placeholders with values of the GUI instance the interaction takes place on (For portability reasons) Supported keys (wall GUIs resolve against the placement, handheld GUIs against the player):
  • x, y, z — block coordinates of the anchor (wall: the top-left item frame; handheld: the player)
  • pos — the anchor as "x y z" (drop-in for command coordinates)
  • world — name of the world the instance is in
  • direction — facing of the instance (wall: placement direction such as NORTH or FLOOR_EAST; handheld: the player's cardinal facing)
  • center — center of the GUI surface as "x y z" (may contain decimals; handheld: the player's exact position)
  • id — wall instance id, or the map id for handheld instances
  • layout — name of the layout
  • offset.&lt;dx&gt;.&lt;dy&gt;.&lt;dz&gt; — anchor shifted by a world-axis offset, as "x y z"
  • rel.&lt;right&gt;.&lt;up&gt;.&lt;front&gt; — anchor shifted relative to the GUI's own orientation, as "x y z": right follows the screen's x-axis, up the screen's upward direction and front points out of the GUI towards the viewer (for handheld GUIs: the player's right/up/facing)
